channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Call of Duty: United Offensive
item.description: Award-winning developer Gray Matter Interactive follows up on the success of Infinity Ward's Call of Duty™ - winner of over 80 Game of the Year and 50 Editors' Choice awards worldwide - with Call of Duty™: United Offensive™.

item.title: Call of Duty®: Black Ops - Rezurrection Content Pack
item.description: Take the battle into space for a new dimension of undead action! Check out the new "Moon" level, 4 re-mastered Zombie lore levels, weapons and more!

item.title: Call of Duty®: Black Ops Escalation Content Pack
item.description: Escalation contains 5 all-new exceptionally varied maps; featuring 4 Multiplayer maps and an epic Black Ops Zombies experience with all-new playable characters.

item.title: Call of Duty®: Black Ops First Strike Content Pack
item.description: First Strike contains 5 new maps featuring 4 new multiplayer maps and a new Zombie experience.

item.title: Liminal Shroud
item.description: Explore surreal liminal spaces, uncover hidden paths, and unravel a haunting mystery. No monsters, no combat… just atmosphere, discovery, and quiet dread.

item.title: Sid Meier's Civilization®: Beyond Earth™
item.description: Sid Meier’s Civilization: Beyond Earth is a new science-fiction-themed entry into the award winning Civilization series. As part of an expedition sent to find a home beyond Earth, lead your people into a new frontier, explore and colonize an alien planet and create a new civilization in space.

item.title: Atomic Heart - Annihilation Instinct
item.description: Annihilation Instinct is included in the Atomic Pass, Gold and Ultimate Edition Embark on a mind-bending journey to discover the truth about NORA as you survive vicious, shape-shifting new enemies with two new weapons and a new ability for your glove.

item.title: Atomic Heart - Blood On Crystal
item.description: Blood On Crystal DLC#4 is included in the Atomic Pass, Gold and Ultimate Edition. Requires the base game Atomic Heart to run. Experience the Atomic Heart's thrilling conclusion with the high-stake Blood On Crystal DLC#4.

item.title: Atomic Heart - Enchantment Under the Sea
item.description: Enchantment Under the Sea DLC#3 is included in the Atomic Pass. Requires the base game Atomic Heart to run. Return to spectacular gameplay as Major P-3 and Twin at his side dive into the new underwater complex of Facility 3826 to save all humanity!

item.title: Beetleball
item.description: Score goals with dungballs in Beetleball, the Greatest Online Multiplayer Class-based Dung Beetle Soccer Game TO EVER EXIST

item.title: Call of Duty® 2
item.description: Call of Duty® 2 redefines the cinematic intensity and chaos of battle as seen through the eyes of ordinary soldiers fighting together in epic WWII conflicts. The sequel to 2003's Call of Duty, winner of over 80 Game of the Year awards, Call of Duty 2 offers more immense, more intense, more realistic battles than ever before, thanks to...

item.title: Grand Tactician: The Civil War (1861-1865)
item.description: Take command of the Union or the Confederacy. Prepare your nation for war, recruit and organize great armies and fleets under legendary commanders like Grant, Lee, Jackson or Farragut, plan cunning maneuvers on an epic campaign map and defeat your enemies in real-time battles!

item.title: Monk Took Book
item.description: A game about organizing, stacking and remembering where you put hundreds of books in a cozy-creepy medieval library. Play solo or with up to three fellow monks.

item.title: Paranormal Cleanup
item.description: Clock in for the worst cleaning shift of your life: Unclog nasty toilets and scrub ectoplasm in this 1-4 player online co-op survival horror game. Get the job done and don't get caught by the entities hunting you!

item.title: Rogue Blight
item.description: Rogue Blight is a rogue-lite with focus on souls-like combat, featuring a Slay The Spire-inspired map system. Fight your way through ever-changing maps. Customize your playstyle based on what you find. Death is punishing. Only skill and persistence will carry you forward.

item.title: Sid Meier's Civilization IV: Colonization
item.description: Sid Meier's Civilization IV: Colonization is the third offering in the award winning Civilization IV series. A re-imagining of the classic Colonization game Sid Meier created in 1994, Sid Meier's Civilization IV: Colonization is a total conversion of the Civilization IV engine into a game experience in which players will lead a European...

item.title: Chaos Front
item.description: A turn-based space mecha mercenary game. You can recruit pilots and captains with varying stories and skills, buy and modify spaceships, mecha, artillery, and fighters, take missions, participate in battles between Galactic Powers, change the situations, and experience different stories.

item.title: Friendly Steps
item.description: A physics-based 1-4 player co-op disaster about getting home after a wild night out. It was a fun night! Now grab your buddies and walk home. IF YOU REMEMBER HOW.

item.title: Sins of a Solar Empire II: Harbinger
item.description: The long wait is over as the deadly faction, the Eidolon, arrives in Trader space! Command the power of corruption, stealth and psionics to conquer all before you in this major expansion for Sins of a Solar Empire II.
